submission.justification:
Sensor-T1 has the best unirradiated single-hit resolution (6.0 um at 150 um), but it reaches only 82.0% hit efficiency after 2e16 neq/cm^2 because of strong charge trapping, failing the >=97% end-of-life requirement for the innermost layer, so it is excluded. Sensor-T2 (99.2%) and Sensor-T3 (98.5%) both pass the radiation requirement. Of these, Sensor-T3 has the better resolution (9.0 um vs 14.0 um unirradiated at 150 um), so it best meets the goal of best single-hit resolution. The 150 um thickness is the only thickness for which simulation results exist, so it is the best-supported choice within the 50-300 um range; no thickness optimisation data was found. Irradiated resolution for T3 was not measured, so the end-of-life resolution is unverified. Both T2 and T3 are compatible with the readout chip and the CO2 cooling and power constraints as documented.</justification>
